It hurts when someone thinks I'm playing with their feelings. My last relationship ended 7 years ago. Upon breaking up, his words were "I started flirting with you and going out with you as a game, just because you were interested in me."

It took me 7 years to fall in love again with someone, to the point of wanting my future to be with them. And I don't want my feelings for her to be misunderstood for playing around. I am someone who puts her own everything in a relationship. I love her so much. She's my sun.

There was no love for me. And I gave him everything I could. I know how bad and horrible having their own feelings played with is. And I wouldn't ever want someone go through it. It destroys you and starts making you lock away from other people.

Eventually 2018 arrived and things started going downhill. From the loss of my grandfather, then my ex best friend throwing me away the day after that loss, me moving to France with a group of 11 strangers, forced to live with them for 1 year.

Luckily that year came to an end, I went back to Italy and started focusing on myself. I was getting better, I was studying a new language and started a diet. I was happy. I also got called for my dream job here in France, so I left Italy again.
